Name: (AT) Farm Stand Variants
Author: Lycanthropire
Description:
[center]I absolutely adore using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43703]Stoel1994's Farm Stall Lite[/url], but it was in [i]desperate [/i]need of some textures to make it look like it's actually stocked!
This AT pack adds several new skins for the Farm Stand, spanning multiple item themes.[/center]
[center]
-
-
-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=4][u]INSTALLATION:[/u][/size][/b]

Make sure you have [i]the latest version[/i] of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] already installed!
After that, just download my mod, unzip it, and drop the [u][AT] Farm Stand Variants[/u] folder into your main mods folder!

Once that's done, you can load your game and use the Paint Bucket (available at Robin's)
on your Farm Stall Lite to choose one of the available textures.

There's flowers, ambiguous produce, fish, minerals, artisan goods, and mixed merchandise versions to choose from.[/center]
[center]As a bonus, I have included a texture made specifically for use with mods like[size=2] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32742]Stoner Valley[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24677]Lost in the Woods[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20583]Nature's Bounty[/url], [/size]etc.!
[size=1](You can use this texture [i]even if you don't have any of those mods installed! [/i]Though...I can't imagine why you'd want to? Lol)[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][u][size=4][b]COMPATABILITY:[/b][/size][/u]

I have not included any specific recolors, [i]however, [/i]all of the colors used in these textures are 30% desaturated from
default vanilla colors. They should fit in well enough with most of the popular recolors, as well as vanilla.
Please feel free to make personal edits if you need things to match better![/center]
[center][/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][u][size=4]EXTRA FILE INFO:[/size][/u][/b]

[b][b]I have now provided an optional download, which contains layered .psd and .xcf files.[/b][/b][/center]
[center][b][b]These are there to make it easier for you to create your own textures for [i]personal use[/i]![/b][/b]
[size=1]Please [i]do not[/i] upload your edits. I may have used vanilla assets as a base, but these still took hours to perfect.[/size]
[size=1]Plus, I'd like to keep as many edits as possible together here, in one pack, for [u]everyone[/u] to use.[/size]

[b][b][color=#93c47d][size=4]If you have any specific requests, feel free to comment and[/size][/color][/b][/b]
[b][b][color=#93c47d][size=4]I'll see what I can do about adding them in a future update![/size][/color][/b][/b]

[b][b][size=2]Please, respectfully, DO NOT feed any of these textures through AI.[/size][/b][/b]
[size=1]I have given you easier ways to make your own edits. You also have the option to ask me to make customs for you directly, for free, any time you like.[/size]
[u][u][size=1]There is NO excuse to disrespect this rule[/size][/u][size=1]. If you are found doing so, you will be blocked from accessing my mods in any and all ways available to me.[/size][/u]
[b][b][size=2]Thank you for your cooperation![/size][/b][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=4][u]OTHER INFO AND CREDITS:[/u][/size][/b]

Note that, while I am aware [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/248063885]Stoel1994[/url] uses AI in their header images, [b][i]I DO NOT CONDONE AI USAGE[/i][/b].
[size=1](I downloaded and began using Farm Stall Lite without looking at their other mods first, and continue to use it mainly because there is no alternative.)[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/2sAlgt6.gif[/img]

Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20749]Herbivoor's Universal Recolors[/url], which is where I pulled the desaturated vanilla assets from.
And, as always, thanks to ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley in the first place. This game is my home. <3
[/center]
[center][/center]
